theme: Mixed: phrasal verbs, idioms and confusing words

pages.title: Break the ice
pages.meaning: to say or do something to make people feel relaxed
examples: He told a joke to break the ice.
Games help break the ice at parties.
tip: Idiom: used when meeting new people

pages.title: Run out of
pages.meaning: to have no more of something left

right.label: For
examples: I've lived here for six years.

pages.title: Once in a blue moon
examples: I eat fast food once in a blue moon.
He calls me once in a blue moon.
tip: Idiom: blue moon -> very rare event
